title: When does the model pay? Interactive health-economic explorer for postpartum readmission risk models (nuMoM2b)
description: Self-contained web page exploring when acting on a postpartum readmission risk model adds economic value over contacting all or no patients, as a function of contact cost, intervention effectiveness, readmission cost and model running cost. Embeds only aggregate risk bins (each with at least 11 readmissions and 11 non-readmissions) from the nuMoM2b test set; no participant-level data. Companion to medRxiv preprint 10.1101/2025.12.16.25342440.
